blocks.text: Sifat + predlog (1): munosabat va his-tuyg'ular

Asosiy juftliklar qizil kitobda o'tilgan: angry **with** / **about**, worried **about**, kind **to** (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars). Bu darsda — odamning boshqalarga munosabatini va his-tuyg'ularini bildiruvchi sifatlar, ayniqsa **bitta sifat ikki predlog bilan ikki xil ma'no** beradigan holatlar: nice **of** / nice **to**, sorry **about** / sorry **for**, angry **with** / **about**. O'zbekchada bu farq kelishikdan emas, gapning qurilishidan bilinadi, shuning uchun inglizcha predlogni ma'noga qarab tanlashni o'rganish kerak.
It's kind of you to ... — bitta harakatga baho

Kimningdir **bitta harakatiga** baho berganda: It was **kind / nice / good / generous / thoughtful / clever / sensible of** you **to** help. Qolip: **sifat + of + kishi + to + fe'l**. Salbiy baho ham xuddi shunday: It was **silly / stupid / careless / rude / mean of** him **to** say that. Harakat vaziyatdan ko'rinib turgan bo'lsa, «to ...» qismi tushib qoladi: Thank you for the flowers — that's very **kind of** you! O'zbekchada bunday gap «Yordam berganingiz — **katta mehribonlik**», «Unday deganim **ahmoqlik** bo'ldi» kabi tarjima qilinadi. Bu qolip haqida batafsil — 65-dars.

rows: It's very **kind of** you to wait.
It was **stupid of** me to forget my passport.
It was **careless of** them to leave the door open.
It's **rude of** him not to reply.
It was **clever of** Tom to book early.

blocks.text: kind to, rude to — kishiga nisbatan xulq

Gap bitta harakat haqida emas, kishining **boshqalarga qanday munosabatda bo'lishi** haqida bo'lsa — **to**: She was very **kind to** me when I was new. Bu guruhda: **nice / kind / good / generous / polite / rude / friendly / unfriendly / fair / cruel / mean to** somebody; friendly bilan **towards** ham ishlatiladi. Qiyoslang: It was **nice of** her to call (bitta harakat — qo'ng'iroq) va She is always **nice to** her neighbours (doimiy xulq).

items.text: Kate was really **nice to** me during my first week at the new office.
items.translation: Yangi ofisdagi birinchi haftamda Keyt men**ga** juda **yaxshi munosabatda** bo'ldi.

items.text: The receptionist was quite **rude to** us, so we complained.
items.translation: Qabulxona xodimi biz**ga** ancha **qo'pollik qildi**, shuning uchun shikoyat qildik.

items.text: It was **generous of** your brother to lend us his car for the whole week.
items.translation: Akangiz mashinasini butun haftaga bizga berib turib, **katta saxiylik qildi**.

blocks.text: angry, annoyed, furious: with — kishi, about — narsa, for — sabab

Qisqa eslatma: **angry / annoyed / furious / cross with** somebody, **about** something (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars). Yangi narsa — sababni ko'rsatish: angry **with** somebody **for** doing something: I was annoyed **with** him **for** being late. Bir gapda ikkala predlog: She was furious **with** her brother **about** the car. **cross** — British English da so'zlashuvdagi «jahli chiqqan». O'zbekchada hammasi `-dan` («sendan jahlim chiqdi»), shuning uchun «angry from / on you» xatosi ko'p uchraydi.
excited, worried, nervous, upset about — voqeaga munosabat

Biror **voqea yoki vaziyat** haqidagi his-tuyg'u — **about**: excited / worried / nervous / anxious / upset / happy / sad / relaxed **about**. O'zbekchada ko'pincha `-dan` (imtihondan xavotirdaman) yoki «... uchun» (to'y uchun hayajondaman). Predlogdan keyin ot yoki **-ing**: nervous **about** giving a speech (→ 60-dars).
pleased, satisfied, disappointed with — natijaga baho

Natija, narsa yoki xizmat sifatiga baho — **with**: pleased / satisfied / delighted / disappointed / happy **with** something: I'm not satisfied **with** the service. Yangilik yoki vaziyatga ko'pincha **about**: delighted **about** the news. Kishidan hafsalasi pir bo'lsa — disappointed **with** yoki **in** somebody. **fed up / bored with** — bezor bo'lmoq, zerikmoq (fed up with — British English, so'zlashuv).

items.text: Nilufar is really **excited about** her first business trip to London.
items.translation: Nilufar Londonga birinchi xizmat safari**dan** juda **hayajonda**.

items.text: Were you **disappointed with** the hotel, or was it as good as the photos?
items.translation: Mehmonxona**dan hafsalangiz pir bo'ldimi** yoki suratlardagidek yaxshi edimi?

items.text: The director is **pleased with** the results of the first quarter.

blocks.text: surprised, shocked at / by; impressed by / with

Kutilmagan narsaga munosabat — **at** yoki **by**: surprised / shocked / amazed / astonished **at** / **by** the news. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; **by** majhul nisbatdagidek «nima ta'sir qildi» ni ko'rsatadi. **impressed by / with** — biror narsa kuchli taassurot qoldirdi: I was impressed **by** her English. O'zbekchada `-dan` (yangilikdan hayron bo'ldim) yoki `-ga` (bunga hayron qoldim), lekin inglizchada **from** hech qachon ishlatilmaydi. -ed / -ing sifatlar farqi (surprised / surprising) — 98-dars.

items.text: We were all **surprised at** how quickly the new bridge was built.
items.translation: Yangi ko'prik qanchalik tez qurilgani**ga** hammamiz **hayron qoldik**.

items.text: The examiners were **impressed by** Jasur's confident presentation.
items.translation: Jasurning dadil taqdimoti imtihon oluvchilar**da** katta **taassurot qoldirdi**.

items.text: Honestly, I'm **fed up with** this weather — it's rained every day for a week.
items.translation: Rostini aytsam, bu ob-havo**dan bezor bo'ldim** — bir haftadan beri har kuni yomg'ir yog'yapti.

blocks.text: sorry about, sorry for, feel sorry for

**sorry** uch xil ishlatiladi. **sorry about** + vaziyat: Sorry **about** the noise. **sorry for / about** + o'z harakatingiz (uzr): I'm sorry **for** shouting at you. Ko'pincha shunchaki: I'm sorry I shouted. **feel / be sorry for** + kishi — achinmoq, rahmi kelmoq: I feel sorry **for** him. O'zbekchada birinchi ikkisi — «uzr, kechirasiz», uchinchisi — «unga achinaman, rahmim keladi». Yomon xabarga hamdardlik: I'm **sorry to hear about** your father.

rows: **Sorry about** the mess in the kitchen.
I'm **sorry for** being so rude yesterday.
I **feel sorry for** the new intern.
I was **sorry to hear about** your exam.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «It was kind from you» → **kind of** you; «She was very kind with me» → **kind to** me; «I'm angry on you» → **angry with** you; «I'm angry with the delay» → **angry about** the delay; «surprised from the news» → **surprised at / by**; «satisfied from the result» → **satisfied with**; «Men unga achinaman» → «I'm sorry about him» emas, **I feel sorry for him**; «I'm boring with this job» → **I'm bored with** (→ 98-dars).

O'zingizga savol bering: kishi **bitta ish qildimi** (qo'ng'iroq qildi, yordam berdi)? → **of**: kind **of** you. Kishi **boshqalarga qanday**? → **to**: kind **to** everyone. Achinish ma'nosidagi **sorry for** doim kishi bilan va ko'pincha **feel** bilan keladi: feel sorry **for** + kishi.
Bog'lanish: ot + predlog (a reason for, damage to) — 129-dars; boshqa sifatlar (afraid of, good at, married to) — 131-dars; It's nice of you to ... qolipi — 65-dars; -ed / -ing sifatlar — 98-dars.

examples.title: It's kind **of** you to ...: judging an action
examples.description: Kishining bitta harakatiga baho: sifat + **of** + kishi + **to** + fe'l. Ijobiy (kind, nice, generous, thoughtful, clever) va salbiy (silly, stupid, careless, rude) baho.

sentences.text: It's very **kind of** you to drive me to the station so early.
sentences.translation: Meni shunday erta vokzalga olib borayotganingiz — **katta mehribonlik**.

sentences.text: It was **stupid of** me to leave my laptop in the car.
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni mashinada qoldirganim — **ahmoqlik** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Thank you for the flowers — that was so **thoughtful of** you!
sentences.translation: Gullar uchun rahmat — **juda e'tiborlisiz**!

sentences.text: Wasn't it a bit **careless of** Bekzod to send the email without checking it?
sentences.translation: Bekzodning xatni tekshirmasdan yuborgani biroz **beparvolik** emasmidi?

sentences.text: How **generous of** your parents to pay for the whole trip!
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz butun sayohat uchun pul to'lab berishibdi — **qanday saxiylik**!

sentences.text: Booking the tickets early was **clever of** Dilnoza — prices went up the next day.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni oldindan bron qilib, Dilnoza **aqllilik qildi** — ertasi kuni narxlar oshib ketdi.

sentences.text: I think it was rather **rude of** them not to say goodbye.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, xayrlashmay ketishgani ancha **qo'pollik** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Forgetting his own birthday? That's so **typical of** Oliver!
sentences.translation: O'z tug'ilgan kunini unutibdimi? Oliver**ning odati** shu!

sentences.text: Was it **sensible of** the company to cut the training budget during a crisis?
sentences.translation: Inqiroz paytida o'qitish byudjetini qisqartirish kompaniyaning **oqilona** qadami bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: It's **nice of** you to offer, but I can carry these boxes myself.
sentences.translation: Taklifingiz uchun rahmat, **yaxshi niyat** qildingiz, lekin bu qutilarni o'zim ko'tara olaman.

examples.title: **kind to**, **rude to**: how people treat others
examples.description: Kishining boshqalarga doimiy munosabati — **to**: kind / nice / polite / rude / friendly / fair / cruel / mean to. Qiyoslang: nice **of** you (harakat) va nice **to** me (munosabat).

sentences.text: Everyone at the hostel in Edinburgh was really **friendly to** us.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdagi xostelda hamma biz**ga** juda **samimiy** edi.

sentences.text: Please be **polite to** the customers, even when they're difficult.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar qiyin bo'lsa ham, ular**ga xushmuomala** bo'ling.

sentences.text: Why were you so **rude to** your sister at dinner?
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatda nega singling**ga** bunchalik **qo'pollik qilding**?

sentences.text: My first boss was strict but always **fair to** everyone in the team.
sentences.translation: Birinchi boshlig'im qattiqqo'l, lekin jamoadagi hamma**ga** doim **adolatli** edi.

sentences.text: Children can sometimes be very **cruel to** classmates who look different.
sentences.translation: Bolalar ba'zan boshqacha ko'rinishdagi sinfdoshlari**ga** juda **shafqatsiz** bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Don't be **mean to** your little brother — he only wants to play with you.
sentences.translation: Ukang**ga yomon munosabatda bo'lma** — u faqat sen bilan o'ynamoqchi.

sentences.text: It was **nice of** Sarah to call, and she's always **nice to** my parents too.
sentences.translation: Saraning qo'ng'iroq qilgani **yaxshi bo'ldi**, u ota-onam**ga** ham doim **yaxshi munosabatda**.

sentences.text: The nurses were extremely **kind to** my grandfather during his stay in hospital.
sentences.translation: Bobom kasalxonada yotganida hamshiralar **unga** nihoyatda **mehribonlik qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Is the new manager **friendly towards** the older staff, or does she ignore them?
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer keksa xodimlar**ga samimiy munosabatdami** yoki ularni e'tiborsiz qoldiradimi?

sentences.text: Madina was **good to** me when I first arrived in Tashkent and didn't know anyone.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga ilk bor kelib, hech kimni tanimaganimda Madina men**ga yaxshilik qilgan**.

examples.title: **angry with** somebody **about** / **for** something
examples.description: Kishiga — **with**, narsaga — **about**, sababga — **for** + -ing: annoyed with him for being late. angry, annoyed, furious, cross.

sentences.text: The teacher was **annoyed with** the students **for** talking during the test.
sentences.translation: Test paytida gaplashgani **uchun** o'qituvchining talabalar**dan jahli chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Are you still **angry about** what I said at the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda aytgan gapim**dan** hali ham **jahlingiz chiqyaptimi**?

sentences.text: Kate was **furious with** the airline **about** her lost luggage.
sentences.translation: Yo'qolgan yuki **tufayli** Keyt aviakompaniya**dan qattiq g'azablandi**.

sentences.text: Please don't be **cross with** me — I didn't mean to break your cup.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, men**dan jahlingiz chiqmasin** — kosangizni atayin sindirmadim.

sentences.text: My father gets **annoyed about** the smallest things when he's tired.
sentences.translation: Dadam charchaganda eng mayda narsalar**dan** ham **asabiylashadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur was **angry with** himself **for** missing such an easy goal.
sentences.translation: Jasur shunday oson golni o'tkazib yuborgani **uchun** o'zi**dan jahli chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Residents are **angry about** the plan to build a car park on the playground.
sentences.translation: Aholi o'yin maydonchasi o'rnida avtoturargoh qurish rejasi**dan g'azablangan**.

sentences.text: Why is Emma so **annoyed with** you? — I forgot to call her back.
sentences.translation: Nega Emmaning sen**dan** bunchalik **jahli chiqqan**? — Unga qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutibman.

sentences.text: Nobody was more **furious about** the decision than the players themselves.
sentences.translation: Bu qaror**dan** hech kim o'yinchilarning o'zichalik **g'azablanmadi**.

sentences.text: I'm not **angry with** you **about** the money; I'm upset that you lied.
sentences.translation: Pul **masalasida** sen**dan jahlim chiqqani** yo'q; yolg'on gapirganingdan xafaman.

examples.title: Feelings about events: **excited** / **nervous about**
examples.description: Voqea yoki vaziyatga nisbatan his-tuyg'u — **about**: excited, worried, nervous, anxious, upset, happy, sad, relaxed about. Keyin ot yoki -ing.

sentences.text: Bekzod is really **excited about** starting his new job in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Manchesterdagi yangi ishini boshlash**dan** juda **hayajonda**.

sentences.text: Were you **nervous about** your first driving lesson?
sentences.translation: Birinchi haydash darsingiz oldidan **hayajonlanganmidingiz**?

sentences.text: Nilufar was **upset about** the comments people left under her video.
sentences.translation: Odamlar videosi ostida qoldirgan izohlar**dan** Nilufar **xafa bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Many parents feel **anxious about** how much time their children spend online.
sentences.translation: Ko'p ota-onalar farzandlari internetda qancha vaqt o'tkazayotgani**dan xavotirda**.

sentences.text: I'm not very **happy about** the new rules at work, to be honest.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, ishdagi yangi qoidalar**dan** unchalik **mamnun emasman**.

sentences.text: Everybody's so **excited about** the concert that the tickets sold out in an hour.
sentences.translation: Hamma konsert**ni** shunchalik **intiqlik bilan kutyapti**ki, chiptalar bir soatda sotilib ketdi.

sentences.text: There's no point being **worried about** the results now — the exam is over.
sentences.translation: Endi natijalar**dan xavotirlanishning** foydasi yo'q — imtihon tugadi.

sentences.text: Sarah felt **sad about** leaving Oxford after five wonderful years.
sentences.translation: Besh ajoyib yildan keyin Oksfordni tark etayotgani**dan** Sara **mahzun** edi.

sentences.text: What are you so **worried about**? — My presentation tomorrow, of course.
sentences.translation: Nima**dan** bunchalik **xavotirdasiz**? — Ertangi taqdimotimdan, albatta.

sentences.text: Aziz seemed quite **relaxed about** the interview, which surprised everyone.
sentences.translation: Aziz suhbat**ga** ancha **xotirjam qarayotgandek** edi, bu hammani hayron qoldirdi.

examples.title: Results: **pleased** / **disappointed** / **fed up with**
examples.description: Natija, narsa, xizmatga baho — **with**: pleased, satisfied, delighted, disappointed, happy with. fed up / bored with — bezor bo'lmoq. Kishidan hafsalasi pir bo'lsa — disappointed in / with.

sentences.text: The coach was **pleased with** the way the team played in the second half.
sentences.translation: Murabbiy jamoaning ikkinchi bo'limdagi o'yini**dan mamnun** edi.

sentences.text: Are you **satisfied with** your new internet provider?
sentences.translation: Yangi internet provayderingiz**dan qoniqasizmi**?

sentences.text: We were a bit **disappointed with** the food, but the view was amazing.
sentences.translation: Ovqat**dan** biroz **hafsalamiz pir bo'ldi**, lekin manzara ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: Grandma was **delighted with** the scarf you sent her from Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdan yuborgan sharfingiz**dan** buvim **juda xursand bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: I'm **fed up with** cooking every evening — let's order something tonight.
sentences.translation: Har kecha ovqat pishirish**dan bezor bo'ldim** — bugun biror narsa buyurtma qilaylik.

sentences.text: Students quickly get **bored with** lectures that don't have any examples.
sentences.translation: Talabalar misollarsiz ma'ruzalar**dan** tez **zerikib qolishadi**.

sentences.text: Was the client **happy with** the design, or did she ask for changes?
sentences.translation: Mijoz dizayn**dan rozi** bo'ldimi yoki o'zgartirishlar so'radimi?

sentences.text: Oliver's parents were **disappointed in** him when he dropped out of university.
sentences.translation: Oliver universitetni tashlab ketganda, ota-onasining **undan hafsalasi pir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, nobody in the office is **satisfied with** the new software.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytganda, ofisda hech kim yangi dastur**dan qoniqmayapti**.

sentences.text: After ten years in the same job, Jasur was **fed up with** routine and decided to retrain.
sentences.translation: Bir ishda o'n yil ishlagach, Jasur bir xillik**dan bezor bo'ldi** va yangi kasb o'rganishga qaror qildi.

examples.title: **surprised at** / **by**, **impressed by** / **with**
examples.description: Kutilmagan narsa — surprised / shocked / amazed / astonished **at** yoki **by**. Kuchli taassurot — impressed **by** / **with**. «from» — hech qachon.

sentences.text: I was **surprised at** how cheap the flights to Samarkand were.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga aviachiptalar qanchalik arzon ekani**ga hayron qoldim**.

sentences.text: Everyone was **shocked by** the news of the factory closing.
sentences.translation: Zavod yopilishi haqidagi yangilik**dan** hamma **larzaga keldi**.

sentences.text: Visitors are always **amazed at** the colours of the tiles in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivaga kelganlar koshinlarning ranglari**ga** doim **lol qolishadi**.

sentences.text: The interviewers were very **impressed by** Madina's knowledge of the market.
sentences.translation: Madinaning bozorni yaxshi bilishi suhbat o'tkazuvchilar**da** katta **taassurot qoldirdi**.

sentences.text: Weren't you **surprised by** his decision to sell the business?
sentences.translation: Uning biznesni sotish haqidagi qarori**dan hayron bo'lmadingizmi**?

sentences.text: We were **astonished at** the size of the bill after just three coffees.
sentences.translation: Bor-yo'g'i uchta qahvadan keyin hisobning miqdori**dan hang-mang bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: James wasn't particularly **impressed with** the hotel room — it was tiny.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasi Jeymsda unchalik **taassurot qoldirmadi** — juda kichkina edi.

sentences.text: Doctors were **amazed by** how quickly the boy recovered after the operation.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin bola qanchalik tez tuzalgani**ga** shifokorlar **hayratda qolishdi**.

sentences.text: Why are you so **surprised at** that? Prices go up every year.
sentences.translation: **Bunga** nega bunchalik **hayron bo'lyapsiz**? Narxlar har yili oshadi.

sentences.text: Fans were **shocked at** the price of tickets for the final, which had doubled since last year.
sentences.translation: Muxlislar final chiptalarining narxi**dan dahshatga tushishdi** — o'tgan yilgidan ikki baravar oshgan edi.

examples.title: **sorry about**, **sorry for**, **feel sorry for**
examples.description: sorry about + vaziyat; sorry for / about + o'z harakati (uzr); feel sorry for + kishi (achinmoq); sorry to hear about (hamdardlik).

sentences.text: **Sorry about** the noise last night — it was my son's birthday.
sentences.translation: Kechagi shovqin **uchun uzr** — o'g'limning tug'ilgan kuni edi.

sentences.text: I'm really **sorry for** shouting at you this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab sizga baqirganim **uchun** chin dildan **uzr so'rayman**.

sentences.text: Everyone **felt sorry for** the little boy who had lost his dog.
sentences.translation: Itini yo'qotgan kichkina bola**ga** hamma**ning rahmi keldi**.

sentences.text: We're **sorry about** the delay and will refund part of your ticket.
sentences.translation: Kechikish **uchun uzr so'raymiz** va chiptangiz pulining bir qismini qaytaramiz.

sentences.text: Don't **feel sorry for** Tom — he chose to leave the team himself.
sentences.translation: Tom**ga achinmang** — jamoani tark etishni o'zi tanlagan.

sentences.text: Dilnoza said she was **sorry about** forgetting our meeting.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uchrashuvimizni unutgani **uchun uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: I **feel** really **sorry for** people who have to commute two hours a day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ikki soat yo'l bosib ishga boradigan odamlar**ga** chindan **achinaman**.

sentences.text: We were so **sorry to hear about** your grandmother — is she any better now?
sentences.translation: Buvingiz haqida **eshitib, juda afsuslandik** — ahvollari yaxshilandimi?

sentences.text: Aren't you **sorry for** what you said to her? — Yes, and I've already apologised.
sentences.translation: Unga aytgan gaplaringiz**dan pushaymon** emasmisiz? — Ha, allaqachon uzr so'radim.

sentences.text: Nobody **feels sorry for** a footballer who earns millions, even when he's injured.
sentences.translation: Millionlab pul topadigan futbolchi**ga**, hatto jarohatlanganda ham, hech kim**ning rahmi kelmaydi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: after the job interview
examples.description: Suhbat: ikki do'st ish suhbatidan keyin gaplashadi — nice of, nervous about, friendly to, impressed by, disappointed with, annoyed with, surprised at, sorry for, excited about.

sentences.text: — Hi Aziz! It's so **nice of** you to call. How did the interview go?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Aziz! Qo'ng'iroq qilganing **juda yaxshi bo'ldi**. Suhbat qanday o'tdi?

sentences.text: — Not bad, but I was terribly **nervous about** the technical questions.
sentences.translation: — Yomon emas, lekin texnik savollar**dan** juda **hayajonlandim**.

sentences.text: — Were they **friendly to** you, or did they try to scare you?
sentences.translation: — Ular sen**ga samimiy** bo'lishdimi yoki seni qo'rqitishga urinishdimi?

sentences.text: — Very friendly, actually. And they seemed **impressed by** my portfolio.
sentences.translation: — Aslida juda samimiy. Portfoliom ularda **taassurot qoldirgandek** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: — That's great! So why do you sound so **disappointed with** yourself?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r-ku! Unda nega o'zing**dan** bunchalik **norozidek** gapiryapsan?

sentences.text: — Because I was **annoyed with** myself for forgetting the name of their director.
sentences.translation: — Chunki ularning direktori ismini unutib qo'yganim uchun o'zim**dan jahlim chiqdi**.

sentences.text: — Oh, don't worry. I'm sure they weren't **surprised at** a little mistake like that.
sentences.translation: — E, qo'ysang-chi. Ishonchim komil, bunday kichik xato**ga** ular **hayron bo'lishmagan**.

sentences.text: — Maybe. Anyway, I'm **sorry for** keeping you on the phone so long.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Nima bo'lganda ham, seni telefonda shuncha ushlab turganim **uchun uzr**.

sentences.text: — Don't be silly! I'm **excited about** your news — tell me as soon as they call.
sentences.translation: — Qo'ysang-chi! Yangiliging**dan** men ham **hayajondaman** — qo'ng'iroq qilishsa, darhol ayt.

sentences.text: — I will. And thanks — it's really **kind of** you to support me like this.
sentences.translation: — Albatta aytaman. Rahmat — meni bunday qo'llab-quvvatlayotganing **katta mehribonlik**.
